ModMetaData.name: A Sloth Mod Renew
ModMetaData.author: ThatRubishGamer - 1.6 port: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
The sloth, brought forward to RimWorld 1.6. A small, slow, harmless animal that sleeps most of the day and eats the rest.
I am not the author of this mod. The sloth is ThatRubishGamer's; all I did was the work needed to make it run on 1.6. Credit goes to them, mistakes in the update are mine. If they come back to it, or ask me to take this down, it comes down.
Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2253087891 - last supporting 1.3, last updated in July 2021. Abandoned, not withdrawn.
WHAT IT ADDS
One animal, the sloth. Body size 0.15, a fifth of an ordinary animal's hunger, half its health, thirteen years of life. It moves at 0.7 cells per second, slower than a colonist walking. It eats rough vegetation, yields light leather, cannot be trained at all, and will never turn manhunter: not when a taming attempt fails, not when it is hurt.
It lives in tropical rainforest and tropical swamp, and exotic traders sell it. See "What this update changed on purpose" below: in the original it was in neither place.
WHAT CHANGED IN THE 1.6 UPDATE
One line, and it is the line that mattered. Wildness stopped being a field of RaceProperties in 1.6 and became a StatDef declared under statBases. The old form is not an error, it is simply never read, and the stat defaults to -1, outside the range the game uses - so the sloth tamed for almost nothing instead of sitting at 0.50. Nothing else in the file needed touching, and no balance value was changed.
WHAT THIS UPDATE CHANGED ON PURPOSE
The line above is repair. This is not, and it is said plainly rather than buried: the original sloth could not be obtained in a normal game at all. It was in no biome's wild animal list, so it never spawned on a map, and its only trade tag was AnimalCommon, which no trader in Core or the five expansions sells or buys. Vanilla's hare carries that tag alone and is caught in the wild, never bought. An animal in neither place exists only in the files.
Two changes fix that, and nothing else was touched. The tag AnimalUncommon was added, the one carried by the monkey, the iguana, the tortoise and the megasloth, and the one exotic caravans and orbital ships actually sell. And a patch adds the sloth to tropical rainforest at 0.5 and tropical swamp at 0.4, read against the monkey at 1 and the guinea pig at 0.25 already in those lists.
If you run More Vanilla Biomes or Alpha Biomes, the sloth is added to their jungles too: cloud forest 0.5, miasmic mangrove 0.4, mycotic jungle 0.3, and feralisk infested jungle 0.05, that last one low because every animal in that biome is, the spiders having eaten the difference. Neither mod is required. Without them those patches do nothing at all.
A purist port would have left both alone. Left alone here means an animal nobody can ever meet.
Content mod: removing it mid-save will lose any sloth already in play.
Source, changelog and the full account of the port: https://github.com/vbardales/Rimworld-A-Sloth-Mod-Renew
The original states no licence anywhere - no file, nothing in its About, no repository, nothing on its Workshop page. This port therefore rests on the Workshop's own custom for abandoned mods: named credit to the author, and a takedown on request.
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
The update work was done with the help of an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic).
